The dominance of historical ornament and stylistic revival over practical design
The widespread adoption of pilotis in European architecture, which emphasized structural elevation and open ground floors

baseline.text: In a multi-story office building with both analog and IP intercom systems, what is the primary reason IP intercoms are preferred for modern installations?

IP intercoms reduce cabling requirements and integrate seamlessly with access control and BMS platforms
Analog systems are more cost-effective for large-scale deployments, particularly in retrofitting older buildings where existing infrastructure can be utilized
IP intercoms require less maintenance and do not need voltage regulators in Philippine facilities, making them more reliable in areas with fluctuating power supply

rationale.a: Analog systems actually suffer from range limitations and cabling challenges; IP systems leverage existing network infrastructure.
rationale.c: While analog systems have lower initial cost, IP systems offer superior integration and reduced installation complexity that offsets this advantage.
rationale.d: Both IP and analog systems require proper power management in Philippine facilities due to voltage fluctuations; this is not a differentiating factor.
rationale.correct: IP intercoms transmit audio and video over existing Ethernet infrastructure, reducing cabling requirements compared to dedicated analog pairs. They integrate seamlessly with modern access control systems and Building Management Systems, providing a unified platform for security operations.
rationale.takeaway: IP intercoms are preferred in modern buildings because they leverage existing network infrastructure and provide seamless integration with access control and BMS systems.

title: lea-util-004-06-cctv-systems

baseline.text: Which camera type is designed for discrete indoor surveillance with aesthetic integration and provides operational discretion by concealing the viewing direction?

options.text: Bullet camera mounted on external walls, typically used for outdoor surveillance
Dome camera installed flush against ceilings
PTZ camera with operator control, allowing for manual adjustment of viewing angles
Panoramic fisheye camera, offering a 360-degree view without moving parts

rationale.a: Bullet cameras are cylindrical and typically mounted on external walls for perimeter surveillance, not for discrete indoor use.
rationale.c: PTZ cameras are used for dynamic coverage of critical zones but do not provide aesthetic integration or directional concealment.
rationale.d: Panoramic fisheye cameras provide wide coverage but are not typically chosen for discrete indoor surveillance with directional ambiguity.
rationale.correct: Dome cameras are mounted flush against ceilings or walls and offer aesthetic integration with interior design. The dome housing protects optics and provides operational discretion because observers cannot easily determine the viewing direction.
rationale.takeaway: Dome cameras are the preferred choice for indoor environments requiring both discrete operation and aesthetic integration.
